feeds.title: The New Social Worker
feeds.description: The New Social Worker is a free online quarterly magazine for social work students, recent graduates, educators, and practitioners. It focuses on career development for professional social workers. It publishes articles on social work careers, education, ethics, technology, books, and more.

feeds.title: The School of Social Work
feeds.description: The School of Social Work represents a remarkable collective of researchers, teachers, and practitioners. They draw on the most recent research, new learning innovations, and a strong interdisciplinary focus to provide a unique interdisciplinary educational experience for our students.

feeds.title: Health & Social Care Workforce Blog
feeds.description: Health & Social Care Workforce is the blog of the NIHR Policy Research Unit in Health and Social Care Workforce at King's College London. Our writing here focuses on workforce issues in the UK health and social care sector.

feeds.title: Social work with adults
feeds.description: Insights, updates, and reflections from the Chief Social Worker for Adults and others working in the field.

feeds.title: Social Care Blog
feeds.description: Social care blog from the Department of Health shares news, views and information updates for anyone working in - or receiving support from - the care and support sector.

feeds.title: RWABhagidari | RWAs Online News Channel
feeds.description: RWABhagidari is the largest network of Resident Welfare Associations - RWAs of Delhi for regularly raising various Social & Civic issues, concerning the general public, on different platforms.

feeds.title: National Association of Social Workers
feeds.description: National Association of Social Workers (NASW) blogs educate the public about the services social workers provide, keep members and the social work profession informed about association activities, and help social workers interact with the media.

feeds.title: Agents of Change Social Work Test Prep Blog
feeds.description: The Agents of Change blog covers a wide variety of social work content including how to balance education, careers, and licensure.

feeds.title: Social Work Career
feeds.description: This blog by Dorlee Michaeli , an LMSW, covers mental health, social work resources, interviews with professionals on modalities and practices, licensing exam tips and more

feeds.title: Gary Direnfeld
feeds.description: Gary Direnfeld is a social worker with more than 34 years of experience working with parents, teens and young children. With a private practice located in Dundas and Georgina, Ontario, he provides counseling, mediation and assessment services on most matters of family life

feeds.title: Re-Imagining Social Work
feeds.description: Re-Imagining Social Work (RSW) is a collective of social workers, social work academics, researchers and others who share a passion for, and a commitment to the development of modern, progressive, inclusive, democratic, and culturally responsive social work services in Aotearoa New Zealand.

feeds.title: Teaching & Learning in Social Work
feeds.description: The purpose of Teaching & Learning in Social Work is to write about my work with BSW students, creating a record of different pedagogical approaches, success stories (and failures) and new ideas. I also hope to provide a space for BSW students to share about their learning and journey to becoming a social work professional.

feeds.title: Nicole Clark Consulting
feeds.description: Hi I'm Nicole Clark. I'm a social worker, and I work with nonprofits, schools, government agencies and social services to create engaging and impactful programming and services for that honor the lived experiences of women and girls of color.

feeds.title: Beyond Advocacy
feeds.description: CRISP functions as an independent, non-partisan Congressional policy institute that represents the interests of the social work profession.

feeds.title: UT Social Work Blog
feeds.description: The Steve Hicks School of Social Work blog at the University of Texas at Austin shares news, research updates, and stories about students, faculty, and community initiatives. It focuses on social justice, education, and the real-world impact of social work practice. The blog features posts about conferences, research programs, alumni achievements, and events, highlighting the school's commitment to advancing social work and community engagement.

feeds.title: The Social Work Cafe Blog
feeds.description: The Social Work Cafe blog shares insights and reflections on social work practice, leadership, and professional growth. It discusses key topics such as the purpose of social work, staying motivated in the field, and building a strong professional identity, offering guidance for students and practitioners alike.

feeds.title: Kylie The Creative Social Worker Blog
feeds.description: Hi there, I'm Kylie! I currently work as an EC-8th school social worker. Making things relatable and engaging for my students is my jam. I love coming up with creative ways and resources that help them make deeper connections.

feeds.title: The Social Work Graduate
feeds.description: The Social Work Graduate site is a resource for social work graduates that contains a variety of social work practice approaches.

feeds.title: Community Care
feeds.description: Community Care is a specialist website dedicated to all areas of the social care profession. Our website is the leading online medium for those working in social care and it contains all of the articles that have been published both in Community Care magazine and online since 1995. Inspiring excellence in social care. Read the latest social work and social care news, opinion and analysis and find your perfect social work or social care job

feeds.title: information for practice
feeds.description: To help social service professionals throughout the world conveniently maintain an awareness of news regarding the profession and emerging scholarship.

feeds.title: American Academy of Social Work and Social Welfare
feeds.description: Stay updated with the latest news, fellow achievements, publications, and research in social work and social welfare.

feeds.title: SWTP Blog
feeds.description: The Social Work Test Prep blog provides helpful tips and study strategies for social workers preparing for licensing exams such as the ASWB Bachelors, Masters, and Clinical levels. It covers topics like understanding exam questions, key interventions, managing test anxiety, and guidance for post-exam steps.

feeds.title: suesspicious minds
feeds.description: Suesspicious Minds is a blog that focuses on family law, child protection, and social work practice. It provides detailed analyses of court cases and legal decisions, offering insights into how the legal system interacts with social work and child welfare issues.

feeds.title: International Federation of Social Workers
feeds.description: International Federation of Social Workers (IFSW) is a global organisation that represents national social work associations from around the world and advocates for social justice, human rights and social development through supporting social work practice, education and policy.

feeds.title: RadicalSocialWorker Blog
feeds.description: This blog contains content which reflects my perspectives regarding social issues and social justice. Some blog postings may contain evidence-based content, while others will be solely an expression of my thoughts and observations.

feeds.title: Global Social Service Workforce Alliance Blog
feeds.description: The blog serves as a platform to highlight challenges and promising practices within the social service workforce. It features posts on workforce mapping, advocacy, worker profiles, and key issues impacting social service workers around the world.

feeds.title: SSWAA Blog
feeds.description: The School Social Work Association of America empowers school social workers and promotes the profession of school social work to enhance the social and emotional growth and academic outcomes of all students.

feeds.title: The AI Social Worker Blog
feeds.description: Explore our blog for social workers covering ethical AI use, innovations in social work, and real-world strategies for navigating change, burnout, and documentation.

feeds.title: Continued » Social Work
feeds.description: Articles about Social Work and Social Work CEs. A knowledge base from continued.com

feeds.title: Social Justice Solutions
feeds.description: Social Justice Solutions is a social worker conceived and operated organization born out of the Stony Brook School of Social Welfare's commitment to active participation in creating a socially just world. Social Justice Solutions is a forum to promote the exploration of social welfare policy, social work practice and politics in general.

feeds.title: Creative Social Worker
feeds.description: Creative Social Worker is a blog where creative expression and social emotional wellbeing intersect to provide a space for social workers and therapists to share useful and engaging ideas and resources.

feeds.title: Social Workers Speak
feeds.description: Social Workers Speak gives you a chance to influence how the entertainment industry and news media depicts the social work profession and issues social workers care about.

feeds.title: The Guardian - Social life blog
feeds.description: Social life blog provides a space for people working in, or with, social care to write about a personal issue relating to their work. Maybe they entered the profession in a unique way, or perhaps they have some advice to share.

feeds.title: Social Work Success Path
feeds.description: I'm Manicka Thomas. I'm a Clinical Social Workers, mentor and content creator. This is the intersection of Social Work education and real life. Where I've created a community for Social Workers, Therapists and Helping Professionals, just like you! I want to be your resource in all things career planning. I believe you can truly have a fulfilling 360 degree life as a Social Worker, where YOU design the career you love and teach what you know!

feeds.title: Social Work Haven
feeds.description: Hi there! I'm Angy. The creator of Social Work Haven. I am a Social Worker, Practice Educator Mentor, and Best Interests Assessor. I created this motivational and educational blog focused on empowering social workers and providing content about social work, personal development, mental health so that we can increase awareness and have conversations about social work, personal development and mental health.

feeds.title: Social Work Tech
feeds.description: Social Work Tech is intended to help practioners, psychotherapists, students, and visionaries in social work (and related fields) to understand how technology tools can help them to be better organized, reach clients in a novel way, and better disseminate/process information.

feeds.title: Notes from an Aspiring Humanitarian - Social Work
feeds.description: Notes from an Aspiring Humanitarian (N.A.H.) will be a platform for my writings on issues of equity and social justice. By exploring social identities through written word, film & video, I hope to continue to expand and enrich conversations about social issues that face our society, and to find ways to take social action while encouraging others to do so as so as well in their own ways.

feeds.title: The Social Worker Blog
feeds.description: My name is Lucy and I've been a child protection social worker for a number of years now. I've created this blog in order to help others who have any questions related to social work, struggling to find a job or are just wanting to find out some information about what it's like being a social worker.

feeds.title: The Social Issue
feeds.description: The Social Issue is run by journalist and commissioning editor Saba Salman. It covers people, places and projects making a difference in society, and issues ranging from community to social enterprise, charity, social care, housing and families.

feeds.title: Kmareka
feeds.description: Kmareka provides views on the news and life from two authors a social worker and a nurse with emphasis on environmental issues, health, social justice, and the influence of corporations.

feeds.title: JaeRan Kim
feeds.description: JaeRan Kim is a place to explore, discover, and think aloud about social work practice, research, ethics, theory, education and policy.

feeds.title: The Masked AMHP
feeds.description: The Masked AMHP is a Approved Mental Health Professional social worker working in a rural England area who tries to explain his work in a variety of interesting and often humorous ways.

feeds.title: The Vintage Social Worker
feeds.description: My name is Jenni. I have been a social worker for nearly fifty years. My passion for all these years and now the subject of my blog. I now write and run occasional training courses about working with children in public care together with my friend David Akinsanya

feeds.title: The Licensed Clinical Social Worker Exam
feeds.description: The Licensed Clinical Social Worker Exam is a blog for those who are taking or considering taking the National Social Worker Clinical Exam.

feeds.title: Michigan Girl's Cafe
feeds.description: Michigan Girl's Cafe is a macro-practice social worker's blog reflecting on graduate school, careers, and social justice issues.

feeds.title: Melanie Sage, Social Work Geek
feeds.description: I blog about the things I breathe: social work, technology, family-centered child welfare practice, the Indian Child Welfare Act, Motivational Interviewing, and social work education.

feeds.title: Save The Social Worker Blog
feeds.description: Social work is never easy. I share tips for students and professionals alike on managing difficulties in social work, ranging from mental health to studies. I trained as a social worker, working to help people through their deepest problems. But I like to define my role as a 'voicesmith', helping people to give voice to their potential.

feeds.title: Antisocial Social Worker Blog
feeds.description: Explore the challenges, insights, and personal stories of a social worker navigating the complexities of the profession, from policy to practice.

feeds.title: CaliforniaSocialWorkEDU Blog
feeds.description: The information presented here on CaliforniaSocialWorkEDU.org took hundreds of hours to gather. It's no secret that California needs bright, motivated, and qualified social workers. To help bridge this gap, we aim to deliver the most up-to-date and accurate information so that prospective social workers can make the best decisions regarding their professional future.

feeds.title: R.E.A.L. Social Workers
feeds.description: R.E.A.L. Social Workers Online Magazine is as much about the uniqueness of individuals as it is about the commonalities that brought each of us to the profession of social work. It is a place where social workers Relax, Empower, Advocate and Learn. It is also a place where we share R.E.A.L. stories and R.E.A.L. solutions to the struggles social workers face on a day to day basis.

feeds.title: The Social Work Podcast
feeds.description: The Social Work Podcast provides information on all things social work, including direct practice (both clinical and community organizing), research, policy, education... and everything in between.

feeds.title: SWHELPER
feeds.description: SWHELPER is a news website dedicated to providing news, information, resources, and entertainment related to social work, social justice, and social good. .

feeds.title: Master of Social Work at USC
feeds.description: The MSW@USC blog is designed to be a forum in which people connected to the program can share their daily experiences, news, events, questions, comments or even general thoughts and opinions on the state of social work today.

feeds.title: The How to Social Worker Blog
feeds.description: The How to Social Worker offers coaching, blogs, consulting, and dialogue for professionals. Posts range from professional development, program development, case management struggles, substance abuse, resistance, crisis intervention, and nearly any 'how to' in-between.

feeds.title: School Social Work
feeds.description: School Social Work is a free online resource and community dedicated to supporting the professional practice of school social workers and other school mental health professionals.

feeds.title: Macro Social Worker
feeds.description: Macro Social Worker is a Minnesota-based association that aims to provide opportunities for macro practitioners to network, support new macro graduates, encourage the study of macro practice knowledge and skills, and represent macro practice social workers in the community.

feeds.title: Stuck on Social Work
feeds.description: My name is Sean Erreger and I am Licensed Clinical Social Worker (LCSW, MSW) in New York State. We often brainstorm resources, cases, anecdotes, and things we have read to help ourselves and our clients make progress.

feeds.title: Social Worker Success
feeds.description: Welcome to Social Worker Success where you learn the habits, tools, and strategies social workers use to be personally and professionally successful.

feeds.title: Social Work Action Network
feeds.description: Social Work Action Network is a network of social work practitioners, academics, students and social welfare service users united in their concern that social work activity is being undermined by managerialism and marketisation, by the stigmatisation of service users and by welfare cuts and restrictions.

feeds.title: Sympathetic Ink: Blog
feeds.description: Sympathetic Ink is a blog by Mimi V. Chapman, MSW, Ph.D. She's a professor at UNC Chapel Hill and currently Chair of the Faculty. In this space, she share perspectives, personal and professional. All opinions are of her own.

feeds.title: (not so) CHEAP SOCIAL WORKER
feeds.description: Hello, and welcome to (not so) Cheap Social Worker! I am a medical social worker living in the expensive Bay Area simply trying to make the most out of life. On this blog, you'll find my ramblings on a variety of topics including social work, money, product reviews, and life in general.
